tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Real analyticity of solutions to the heat equation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0241, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0242 1. ch13:13.19\group Real Analyticity

Let $(\mathcal N^n,h)$ be closed and flat, and let $\partial _tf=\Delta _hf$. Then \[ \sum _{k=0}^{\infty } rac{(2t)^k}{k!}| abla ^kf|^2(x,t) \leq \max _{\mathcal N}|f(\cdot ,0)|^2. \] Thus $f(\cdot ,t)$ is real analytic for every $t>0$.
Proof

\sketch ↗ ex:chow-ii-flat-factorial-analyticity-criterion Flatness gives $(\partial _t-\Delta )| abla ^kf|^2=-2| abla ^{k+1}f|^2$. Hence

\[ (\partial _t-\Delta )\sum _{k=0}^{\ell } rac{(2t)^k}{k!}| abla ^kf|^2 =-2 rac{(2t)^\ell }{\ell !}| abla ^{\ell +1}f|^2\leq 0. \]

The maximum principle, followed by $\ell o \infty $, proves the estimate; the preceding criterion proves analyticity.

□
